title: Everyone in my Roblox town gets admin commands... I got /jump

lines.text: In my Roblox town, every kid gets admin commands on their tenth birthday.
Rich kids get the good ones. Slash fly. Slash speed. Slash giant.
One kid got slash money, and his dad bought him the entire map.
But my family was so poor, we couldn't even afford a house. We lived on the starter spawn.
Every new player who joined the server spawned right on top of my bed.
So on my birthday, the command shop gave me the cheapest one they had.
Slash jump.
Everyone laughed. Someone spammed L in the chat so hard, the whole server lagged.
At school, the rich kids flew over the lunch line. I used my command. I jumped exactly one stud.
The lunch lady gave me half a slice of pizza. It was a decal.
My dad told me, son, it's not the command. It's how you use it.
Then he went back to work at the Robux mine, where he earned one Robux a day.
Then the mayor announced the Tower of Doom. A thousand stages. Nobody had ever beaten it.
The prize? One million Robux.
Every rich kid in town lined up. Fly. Speed. Giant. And me, with slash jump.
On stage one, the flyers hit the anti fly lasers. Bonk.
The speed kids ran straight into the lava. And the giant kid got stuck in the very first door.
But me? I just jumped. Stage after stage after stage.
And every time I used it, my jump got a little bit stronger.
Ten studs. Fifty studs. A hundred studs.
By stage nine hundred ninety nine, I was jumping over clouds.
A plane flew past me. The pilot just typed, what.
I made it to the top. Nobody was there. Just one door, and it said, owner only.
Inside was a computer. And on the screen was my username.
Under it, a message. Congrats. You found the developer command.
Then the whole server froze. And everyone else in my town... disappeared.
Part two if this gets a thousand likes.
